messages.subject: y labels doesn't change
parts:
In the following example, when I updated the y data with another variable 'disp' instead of 'wt', the plot was changed with the new y, but the y label was still 'wt'. I think it would be nice to update the label as well even though I can update the y label manually later.

p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = mpg, y = wt))
p + geom_point()

p + geom_point(aes(colour = factor(cyl),y = disp))  # y label is still 'wt'
p + geom_point(aes(colour = factor(cyl),y = disp)) + scale_y_continuous(name="disp") # y label changed to be 'disp'
p + geom_point(aes(y = disp))


Changhong
